prob = LpProblem("BIBD", LpMinimize)
x = [LpVariable(f"x{i}", lowBound=0, cat='Integer') for i in range(len(triples))]
prob += 0
# pair constraints
for a,b in combinations(range(v),2):
    prob += lpSum(x[i] for i,t in enumerate(triples) if a in t and b in t) == lam
# total blocks
prob += lpSum(x) == 60

prob.solve(PULP_CBC_CMD(msg=0))

counts = [int(value(xi)) for xi in x]
print(sum(counts), counts)

for i,c in enumerate(counts):
    for _ in range(c):
        blocks.append(triples[i])

mat = [[0]*60 for _ in range(10)]
for j, blk in enumerate(blocks):
    for p in blk:
